name: Victor von Doom
summary: The announced central threat of Avengers: Doomsday. On screen, the MCU has shown almost nothing about him so far. Most of what fans 'know' comes from the comics, and this page keeps the two apart.

mcu.text: Robert Downey Jr. will play Victor von Doom in Avengers: Doomsday.
mcu.citation: Marvel Studios Hall H panel, San Diego Comic-Con, 27 July 2024

mcu.text: A hooded figure sits with baby Franklin Richards on Earth-828. A Doom mask is visible on screen; the face is not.
mcu.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene

mcu.text: The hooded figure in that scene is Doctor Doom.
mcu.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene
mcu.note: Strongly implied by the mask and by the Doomsday announcement, but the scene does not name him.

mcu.text: His MCU origin, home universe, powers and motive have not yet been established on screen.
mcu.note: Recorded as an absence: there is no on-screen evidence yet. This will be updated when Doomsday releases.

comics.text: First appeared in Fantastic Four #5 (1962), created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.
Monarch of the small European nation of Latveria. Diplomatic immunity is a recurring part of his character.
Reed Richards' college rival. A failed experiment that Doom blamed on Reed scarred him and drove him behind his iron mask.
A genius who combines advanced science with sorcery. His mother's pact with Mephisto drives many of his storylines.
In Secret Wars (2015), Doom salvages the remains of a dying multiverse after the incursions and rules the patchwork Battleworld as God Emperor Doom.
comics.citation: Secret Wars (2015), Jonathan Hickman & Esad Ribić

open.text: Doom has a specific interest in Franklin Richards.
open.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene
open.note: The staging of the scene points to it. His reason is unknown.

open.text: Doom wants to use Franklin's reality-altering power.
Downey's Doom is a variant of Tony Stark.
open.note: Popular because of the casting. Nothing on screen or in official material supports it yet.

open.text: Doomsday will adapt elements of the comics' incursion and Secret Wars story.
open.note: Avengers: Secret Wars is announced as the next Avengers film, but how closely either film follows the comics is unknown.

openQuestions: Which universe is this Doom from? Is he native to Earth-828?
Why is Doom with Franklin, and what does he want?
Why did Marvel cast Robert Downey Jr., and does the casting matter in-story?

name: Reed Richards
summary: The Fantastic Four's leader and, in the comics, Doom's defining rival. The MCU has shown two versions of him so far.

mcu.text: An Earth-838 variant played by John Krasinski appears briefly and is killed by Wanda.
mcu.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

mcu.text: Pedro Pascal plays the Earth-828 Reed Richards and is confirmed for Avengers: Doomsday.
mcu.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps; Doomsday cast livestream, 26 March 2025

comics.text: Doom and Reed met as college students. Their rivalry is one of Marvel's oldest.

name: Franklin Richards
summary: Reed and Sue's son. His power drew Galactus to Earth-828, and he is the child Doom is seen with.

mcu.text: Galactus wants Franklin because of his extraordinary power.
Seen with a hooded figure holding Doom's mask.
mcu.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene

comics.text: One of Marvel's most powerful reality-warping mutants. He has created entire pocket universes.

name: Loki
summary: No longer just a trickster: Loki is now the being who holds the multiverse's timelines together.

mcu.text: Sits at the End of Time and sustains the branching timelines.
Tom Hiddleston is confirmed in the Avengers: Doomsday cast.

open.text: Doom's plans will threaten or exploit the structure Loki maintains.

name: He Who Remains / Kang
summary: The MCU's original multiverse-saga villain. The thread was dropped, and it stays on the map so the history of the story is clear.

mcu.text: Killed by Sylvie, which triggers the multiverse.
A Council of Kangs is shown preparing for war.
mcu.citation: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania — mid-credits scene

superseded.note: Avengers: The Kang Dynasty was retitled Avengers: Doomsday, with Doom replacing Kang as the central villain.

name: Sam Wilson
summary: The current Captain America, set up as the person who will reassemble the Avengers.

mcu.text: Anthony Mackie is confirmed for Avengers: Doomsday.

name: The New Avengers
summary: Yelena Belova, Bucky Barnes, Red Guardian, John Walker, Ghost and Bob, rebranded by Valentina Allegra de Fontaine.

mcu.text: They are the first on Earth-616 to detect the arrival from another dimension.
